issue_context.title: SLH-DSA coverage test results
issue_context.body:
Running coverage over #26625 and ignoring unused error paths (of where there are many unsurprisingly).  The interesting out is in: [gcov.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18680754/gcov.zip).

1. `crypto/slh_dsa/slh_dsa_key.c` has unused functions:
    - `slh_dsa_key_hash_dup`
    - `ossl_slh_dsa_key_dup`
    - `ossl_slh_dsa_key_to_text`
2. `providers/implementations/keymgmt/slh_dsa_kmgmt.c` has an unused function:
    - `slh_dsa_imexport_types`
3. `providers/implementations/signature/slh_dsa_sig.c` has some unused algorithms defined down the end:
    - `MAKE_SIGNATURE_FUNCTIONS("SLH-DSA-SHA2-192s", sha2_192s);`
    - `MAKE_SIGNATURE_FUNCTIONS("SLH-DSA-SHAKE-192s", shake_192s);`
    - `MAKE_SIGNATURE_FUNCTIONS("SLH-DSA-SHAKE-192f", shake_192f);`
    - `MAKE_SIGNATURE_FUNCTIONS("SLH-DSA-SHAKE-256s", shake_256s);`

So some functions to decide if they should be in or out and some additional algorithms to validate via unit tests.

Also note that `evp_test` currently has no SLH-DSA test data.  This should be added.
